description.value:
Cost: 500eb (Expensive) for 1

Ammo Types Available: Grenades

A marvel of Arasaka engineering that splits limbs from torsos with a swarm of high-wattage lasers.

Grenade Ammunition. Cannot be loaded into Grenade Launchers. When thrown, it hovers in midair above the 2x2m/yds square it would’ve normally landed on. For the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds), it fires lasers in a 6x6m/yds (3x3 Squares) area centered on itself. Anyone that starts their Turn in this area or moves through it during their Turn must beat a DV17 Evasion or Contortionist Check to not be hit by this ammunition.

This ammunition deals 4d6 damage, does not ablate armor, and cannot damage Cover. Damage dealt by this grenade ignores armor entirely if it is lower than SP 12. Armor with a higher SP is still interacted with as normal. Whenever this ammunition causes a Critical Injury, the user rolls twice on the Critical Injury table and chooses one for the victim to suffer. After the grenade’s hovering duration expires, it falls to the ground harmlessly and is considered Destroyed Beyond Repair.

Stack: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
